lots.what_it_is: Box of 11 modern collected comic editions: Jonathan Hickman's Fantastic Four vols 1, 2, 4 and 5 and FF vols 1, 2 and 3 (Marvel, blue spines, a run with gaps: Fantastic Four vol 3 and the later volumes missing), God Hates Astronauts: The Completely Complete Edition (Image, Browne), Harley Quinn: Preludes and Knock-Knock Jokes (DC, Kesel/Dodson) and Sonic Select Book Two (Archie). Modern reprints, not vintage comics. Gowans title: BOX OF ASST COMICS.

lots.guide_summary: A$2 to A$80. Two close Gowans SOLD hammers for boxes of Marvel books ($2 with no bids, $80 with 5 bids), plus one AbeBooks ASKING for a single Hickman volume at about A$29 (rate 1.4388). Two more SOLD results ($50, $60) are only a category guide for floppy superhero comics. No same-title sold evidence.
lots.working: No SOLD entry is the same item (these Hickman/FF volumes plus three others); the two close Gowans results are unidentified Marvel books and sit at $2 and $80, so they cannot set a bid. keep_max 0, flip_max 0. For context only: if the $80 bundle were treated as a same-item sale, keep would be 80/1.198 = 66.8, rounded down to $65.
lots.confidence_reason: Spines read clearly, but there is no same-item SOLD evidence; the close comps are unidentified bundles that range from $2 to $80, and the only priced title is one asking listing.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped; all four researcher entries confirmed in the Gowans API (title, cents, bids, dates match). Correction to the researcher's identification: 11 books, not 12 to 14; Fantastic Four vols 1, 2, 4, 5 and FF vols 1 to 3 (FF vol 3 is not the same as Fantastic Four vol 3), Harley Quinn is Preludes and Knock-Knock Jokes. Added one AbeBooks ASKING entry.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1 spines read: FF vol 3 (Hickman, Bobillo, Dragotta), FF vol 2 (Hickman, Tocchini, Epting, Kitson), Fantastic Four vol 5 (Hickman, Epting, Kitson), FF vol 1 (Hickman, Epting, Kitson), Fantastic Four vol 1 and vol 2 (Hickman, Eaglesham, thinner), God Hates Astronauts Completely Complete Edition (Browne), Harley Quinn Preludes and Knock-Knock Jokes (DC), Sonic Select, Fantastic Four vol 4 (Hickman, Epting, Dragotta, Brooks). Photo 2 shows covers clean, no obvious damage, mix of hard and soft covers likely.
lots.condition: Looks clean and lightly read from the photos; not checked for creases, water damage or loose pages.
lots.question_for_gowans: Are there only these 11 books in the box, and are they in clean condition (no water damage or spine creases)? Which ones are hardcover?

lots.what_it_is: Box of about 19 vintage pony and country children's hardbacks: 13 Monica Edwards (Collins, mostly in dust jackets, several in protective covers): Punchbowl Midnight, Under the Rose, The Wild One, No Mistaking Corker, The Cownappers, Killer Dog, Punchbowl Farm, The Outsider, Punchbowl Harvest, Frenchman's Secret, Fire in the Punchbowl, The Wanderer, Black Hunting Whip; four Joanna Cannan (A Pony for Jean and More Ponies for Jean in jackets, We Met Our Cousins and London Pride in bare cloth); Fair Girls and Grey Horses (Pullein-Thompson sisters' memoir, in jacket); K M Peyton Stealaway (modern black hardback). Editions and printings not visible.

lots.guide_summary: A$18 to A$79 per single book, all ASKING (AbeBooks, mostly UK sellers, postage extra, rate 1 USD = 1.4388 AUD) for five of the titles here. No sold or unsold result for these authors at Gowans or elsewhere I could reach. Three Gowans SOLD results for vintage children's book lots ($37 to $95 hammer) are only a category guide. The lot as a whole is likely worth a fraction of the summed asking prices.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence for Monica Edwards or Joanna Cannan books, so no maximum bid: keep_max 0, flip_max 0. Context only: dealer asking prices of about A$30 to A$80 per Collins or Bodley Head jacketed title suggest the box could be worth well over $100 to a pony-book collector if any are first editions with decent jackets.
lots.confidence_reason: Titles read clearly, but edition, printing and jacket condition are unknown, and all priced evidence is asking only.
lots.dropped_entries: The researcher's only entry was a placeholder with no price, URL or date ('placeholder removed'), so it was dropped and I did the research myself. Corrections to the identification: the red book is London Pride (Joanna Cannan), K M Peyton is Stealaway (not Stowaway), Fair Girls and Grey Horses is by the Pullein-Thompson sisters (not Cannan), and there are 13 Monica Edwards titles including Punchbowl Midnight, No Mistaking Corker, Punchbowl Farm and Frenchman's Secret.
lots.key_photo_findings: Single photo. Collins at the foot of most Monica Edwards spines, jackets present on all 13, several in clear protective covers, some chipping (The Cownappers has a torn spine foot, Under the Rose sunned). Joanna Cannan: A Pony for Jean (Bodley Head jacket, worn ends), More Ponies for Jean (jacket in protective cover), We Met Our Cousins and London Pride in red cloth without jackets, sunned. Fair Girls and Grey Horses has a jacket with a pencil price at the tail. Stealaway is a later slim black hardback. No title pages shown, so no edition read.
lots.condition: Used vintage hardbacks, jackets with wear, chips and sunning; internal condition, ex-library marks and inscriptions unknown.
lots.question_for_gowans: How many books are in the box in total? Can you check the title page backs of the Monica Edwards books for first edition statements, and whether any are ex-library or have torn or missing pages?
